title: Student Assistant - Market Research
description_md:
We’re looking for two student assistants to join our research team in Copenhagen: one supporting our container team and one supporting our bulk/tankers team.

This is a role for someone who is analytically curious, structured, and eager to learn, with an interest in international trade, data, and translating complex market drivers into clear and structured insights.

*(Kort uddrag fra Jobindex – se hele opslaget via linket.)*
